summary: Two backcountry skiers were caught and injured in an avalanche at Birthday Chute near East Vail; Vail Mountain Rescue Group and Eagle County paramedics responded to the slide; during the rescue operation Eagle County paramedic Steve Zuckerman, 61, lost consciousness and died despite resuscitation efforts by colleagues and air-medical transport
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle County Paramedic Services
notes: Date pinned: the opened davidsonian.com page (2024-02-28) says the avalanche 'unfolded on Friday' and EMS1 reports Zuckerman died 'responding to a backcountry rescue call on Feb. 23' -> 2024-02-23 (Friday, weekday-verified). The two skiers' names/injuries/outcomes beyond 'trapped beneath the snow, both injured' were not published; no subject fatality was reported -- the single death was the responding paramedic (Beaver Creek Ski Patrol veteran 25+ years; Eagle County paramedic since 2008 part-time, full-time since 2013; SAR team member and field trainer; cause of death not released).
